index.consent.title: Your rights and our commitment
index.consent.who_we_are_text: IDENTIFLY is a digital contact card application. Data controller: Jhonatan M. Ortiz (Hydra Apex Labs). Privacy contact: privacidad@identifly.app. Full details of the controller in the Privacy Policy.
index.consent.data_processed_title: What data we process and where
index.consent.data_processed_text:
On your device: your card (photo, name, phone numbers, social links and contact details), your password (protected via hash, never in plain text) and your preferences. It only leaves your device when you decide to share it via QR or link.

On our servers: only your email and your plan, to manage your account, verification and subscription. For security, your IP address is stored irreversibly transformed (never in plain form) for a maximum of 24 hours to limit abuse.

Payments: handled by Stripe. We never see or store your card details.

Business card: if you publish it, its content is stored on our servers so it can be viewed via its public link, until you delete your account.

Document scanning (optional): performed entirely on your device. The file is never sent to any server.

Share links expire after 30 days.
index.consent.legal_basis_text: Managing your account and subscription is necessary to provide you the service (Art. 6.1.b GDPR). Billing data is kept due to a legal obligation (Art. 6.1.c). Anti-abuse measures (such as the fingerprint that prevents reusing the trial period) are based on our legitimate interest in protecting the service (Art. 6.1.f).
index.consent.providers_text: Cloudflare (hosting), Resend (email delivery) and Stripe (payments). Some process data outside the EU, in the US, under GDPR safeguards (EU-US Data Privacy Framework or standard contractual clauses).
index.consent.retention_text:
Your account data is kept for as long as you have an account and is deleted from our servers as soon as you delete it. Billing data is kept for the period required by law. Verification codes expire after 10 minutes.

If you delete your account, we keep an irreversible fingerprint of your email for 24 months, which does not allow us to identify you, solely to prevent the trial period from being used more than once.
index.consent.rights_text: Access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability and objection. You can delete your account yourself from the app at any time; for anything else, write to us at privacidad@identifly.app. If you disagree, you can file a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (www.aepd.es).
index.consent.min_age_text: You must be at least 14 years old to use IDENTIFLY.
index.consent.plans_text:
The monthly Pro plan renews automatically. You can cancel it whenever you want: you won't be charged for the next period and you'll keep access until the end of the period already paid for. Periods already paid for are non-refundable. If you delete your account, the subscription is cancelled and access ends at that moment, with no refund.

The Lifetime plan is a one-time payment and is lost if you delete your account. By paying, you agree that the service starts immediately and acknowledge that you lose the 14-day right of withdrawal.

Two-factor verification (2FA) is free for everyone.
index.consent.security_text:
Your access password is designed with certifiable mathematical security criteria:

IDENTIFLY password (minimum 8 characters: letters, numbers and symbols)
The longer and more varied your password, the greater the protection. Each additional character exponentially multiplies the number of possible combinations, making the password practically impossible to break by brute force.

Comparison with a 4-digit numeric PIN:
— 4-digit numeric PIN: 10,000 combinations → cracked in 10 seconds at 1,000 attempts/sec.
— IDENTIFLY password: astronomically higher combinations → radically superior protection.

This level meets and exceeds the appropriate technical measures required under Art. 32 GDPR. Your password never leaves your device: it is stored protected and never sent to any server.
index.consent.lockout_title: Lockout and recovery protocol — GDPR Art. 32
index.consent.lockout_text: For your security, after 3 failed access attempts your account is locked for 30 minutes. IDENTIFLY has a 3-phase recovery process: Phase 1 — a 6-digit backup code sent automatically when you register, which you must keep permanently in your email. Phase 2 — a temporary code sent to your email at the time of recovery. Phase 3 — creating a new master password. If you don't keep your backup code, the only option available is a full data wipe and a new registration from scratch. IDENTIFLY cannot recover your account without this code — keeping it safe is your responsibility.
index.consent.twofa_text: IDENTIFLY offers optional, free two-step verification: in addition to your password, you'll be asked for a 6-digit code that changes every 30 seconds in your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy...). That way, even if someone knew your password, they couldn't get in without your phone.
index.consent.duties_text:
PIN confidentiality: Your access PIN is personal and non-transferable. You must not share it with anyone, not family, not friends, not any third party under any circumstances.

Device custody: You are responsible for not leaving your device unlocked with IDENTIFLY open in front of third parties. You must not lend your phone with the app active.

Personal use: IDENTIFLY is designed for the personal, exclusive use of the account holder. Use by anyone other than the account holder is not permitted.

Accuracy of data: The information you enter must be truthful. Entering data belonging to third parties without their explicit consent is not permitted.

Lawful use: Using IDENTIFLY for illegal or fraudulent activities, or activities that infringe on the rights of others, is prohibited.
index.consent.prohibitions_text:
The following is strictly prohibited:

— Attempting to bypass, hack or manipulate the app's PIN system.

— Using the app to impersonate another person.

— Sharing or publishing screenshots of another user's QR without their consent.

— Attempting to access other users' data by any means.

— Modifying, decompiling or reverse-engineering the app's code.

— Using the app on compromised devices (jailbroken/rooted) that could expose your data.
index.consent.liability_text:
IDENTIFLY is provided "as is", without guarantees of continuous availability. We are not responsible for:

— Data loss due to clearing browser or device data.

— Unauthorized access resulting from the user having shared their PIN.

— Damages resulting from incorrect or careless use of the app.

The user assumes full responsibility for their use of the app and the data they choose to share via the QR.
index.consent.jurisdiction_text:
This application is governed by applicable Spanish and European legislation, including:

— GDPR (EU) 2016/679 — General Data Protection Regulation.

— LOPD-GDD (LO 3/2018) — Spanish Organic Law on Data Protection and Digital Rights Guarantee.

— LSSI-CE — Spanish Information Society Services Act.

— Spanish Penal Code — Arts. 197-201 regarding offences against privacy and the secrecy of communications.

This text is offered translated into several languages for accessibility; in case of discrepancy, the Spanish version prevails.
